recommendedTextbook.title: Basic Technology for Junior Secondary Schools 3
recommendedTextbook.author: P.B. Nwachukwu, O.A. Adebayo, C.O. Ibe

topics.topic: Woodwork Joints: Framing and Widening Joints
subtopics: Classification of woodwork joints: widening joints (butt, tongue and groove, dowel)
Framing joints: mortise and tenon joint, halving lap joints, bridle joints, housing joints
Corner joints: common dovetail joint and finger comb joints for drawer construction
objectives: Construct a standard mortise and tenon joint using mortise chisel, tenon saw, and mallet
Apply PVA wood adhesive and cramp joints securely with sash clamps

topics.topic: Metal Joining Methods: Soldering, Brazing and Welding
subtopics: Soft soldering: lead-tin solder alloy, soldering flux (zinc chloride, resin), electric soldering copper bit
Hard soldering (brazing): spelter brass alloy and borax flux using blowpipes
Fusion welding: electric arc welding (flux-coated electrodes) and oxy-acetylene gas welding
objectives: Explain functions of chemical flux in preventing oxidation and promoting molten metal flow
Execute a clean soft soldered electrical wire splice joint
Wear appropriate welding helmet with shaded filter glass during arc demonstrations

topics.topic: Mechanical Fasteners: Screws, Bolts, Nuts, Studs and Rivets
subtopics: Permanent fasteners (welding, rivets) vs semi-permanent fasteners (bolts, screws)
Types of bolt heads: hexagonal, square, countersunk, Allen socket heads
Locking devices: spring washers, split pins, castle nuts to prevent vibrational loosening
objectives: Differentiate bolts from studs and screws
Identify thread types and apply locking washers on vehicle engine components

topics.topic: Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems: Pascal's Principle & Applications
subtopics: Pascal's Principle: pressure applied to an enclosed liquid is transmitted undiminished in all directions
Mathematical formula: P = F1 / A1 = F2 / A2 and hydraulic force multiplication
Hydraulic applications: hydraulic bottle jack, vehicle hydraulic brake system
Pneumatic systems using compressed air: pneumatic drills, workshop spray painting guns
objectives: Calculate output lifting force on a hydraulic jack slave piston given input effort and piston areas
Trace hydraulic fluid flow from master cylinder to brake calipers in motor vehicles

topics.topic: Electronic Components: Resistors, Capacitors, Diodes & Transistors
subtopics: Passive components: fixed resistors, carbon color coding bands, potentiometers (rheostats)
Capacitors: electrolytic and ceramic capacitors; dielectric storage of electrostatic charge
Semiconductor diodes: p-n junction, forward bias vs reverse bias, rectification of AC to DC
Transistors: bipolar junction transistors (BJT: NPN and PNP) as electronic switches and amplifiers
objectives: Decode 4-band resistor color codes to calculate resistance in Ohms (Ω) with tolerance percentages
Construct a simple half-wave rectifier circuit using a step-down transformer and diode

topics.topic: Building Construction II: Foundation Types and Wall Bonding
subtopics: Functions of foundations (distributing dead and live loads safely to subsoil)
Types of foundations: strip foundation, pad foundation, raft foundation, pile foundation
Brick and block bonding: Stretcher bond, English bond (alternating headers and stretchers), Flemish bond
objectives: Select appropriate foundation types for firm soil (strip) vs swampy coastal soils (raft/pile)
Draw two consecutive courses of brickwork in English bond showing quoin headers and closers

subtopics: Evaluation on woodwork joints, soldering, hydraulics, electronics, and building walls
BECE standardized diagnostic practical test
objectives: Assess pupil performance against BECE Basic Technology criteria

topics.topic: Roofs and Roof Coverings: Timber Trusses & Structural Members
subtopics: Structural members of a timber roof truss: tie beam, rafters, king post, struts, purlins, wall plate
Types of roofs: flat, shed (lean-to), gable, hip, mansard roofs
Roof covering materials: corrugated aluminum sheets, galvanized iron, clay roofing tiles, asphalt shingles
objectives: Draw and label complete structural members of a king post timber roof truss
Explain how roof pitch prevents rain penetration during heavy Nigerian tropical downpours

topics.topic: Automotive Systems: Transmission Clutches and Braking Systems
subtopics: Function of the clutch in motor vehicles (engaging and disengaging engine from gearbox)
Friction clutch components: flywheel, friction clutch disc, pressure plate, release bearing
Vehicle braking systems: disc brakes (rotor and brake pads) vs drum brakes (brake shoes and wheel cylinder)
objectives: Explain operation of a single-plate friction clutch
Compare braking efficiency and heat dissipation between ventilated disc brakes and drum brakes

topics.topic: Domestic Electrical Installation: Consumer Unit & Safety Earthing
subtopics: Parts of domestic electrical installation: service intake cable, kilowatt-hour energy meter, consumer unit
Circuit protection: Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB) and Earth Leakage Circuit Breakers (ELCB/RCD)
The earthing system: earth electrode rod driven into ground, green/yellow protective earth conductor
objectives: Draw schematic diagram of a domestic consumer control unit distribution board
Explain how earth bonding prevents fatal electric shocks if appliance casing becomes live

subtopics: Fault-finding and maintenance of electric pressing iron (thermostat contact points, heating element)
Electric blender maintenance (bearing lubrication, carbon brush replacement, blade coupler)
Safety isolation procedures before disassembling electrical appliances
objectives: Test continuity of a heating element using a digital multimeter
Diagnose and replace worn carbon brushes in small domestic universal motors

topics.topic: BECE Mock Technical Examination & Speed Drafting Drills
subtopics: Comprehensive 3-year junior secondary technical drawing and engineering review
Timed BECE objective and design drawing paper
objectives: Complete standardized BECE examination questions

subtopics: Final examination administration and script moderation
objectives: Complete junior secondary basic technology graduation certification
